Jimi Hendrix - Live in Gothenburg (1970)
Date: September 1, 1970
Venue: Stora Scenen, Liseberg, Gothenburg, Sweden
Source: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=X-onZdJtDVs

Setlist, in order:
(solo)
1. Spanish Castle Magic
2. Killing Floor
3. Hear My Train A-Comin'
4. Message To Love
(solo)
5. Hey Baby
6. In From The Storm
7. Hey Joe
8. Foxy Lady
9. Red House
10. Room Full Of Mirrors
11. Straight Ahead
12. Purple Haze
13. Voodoo Child (Slight Return)
